name: git-avoid-sweeping-operations-with-exclusions
description: Blocks git commands that act on everything they can reach, where the safe forms have to be carved out with exclude_args: a bare `git stash`, and `git config --global` or `--system` writes. Companion to the git-avoid-sweeping-operations rulebook, which holds the subcommand-plus-flag rules in version 1 format. The why and the alternatives live in the git-hygiene-avoid-sweeping-operations skill. Gaps: a value-taking global option such as `git -C <dir>` hides the subcommand, so `git -C repo stash` and `git -C repo config --global ...` aren't caught.
author: nhooey/git-skills

rules.name: stash-sweep
rules.reason: Stashes every change in the tree, others' included. Run `git stash push -- <paths>`, or use a separate worktree.

rules.name: config-global-write
rules.reason: Changes git settings for every repo on the machine. Use `git config --local`, or ask the user first.
